title: Level 5 (World Class) - C-11
notes:
West leads the ♥A against 4♥. West wins the first trick and leads another heart. South must be careful to keep the ♥K in dummy. The contract can be guaranteed by playing for an elimination, but the ♥K may be required as a late dummy entry.

In order to guarantee the contract, South must make the counter-intuitive play of cashing the ♦A, crashing dummy's ♦K, so that the ♦2 can be ruffed in the dummy to eliminate that suit (as before the ♥K must be preserved). Declarer continues by leading a small spade toward the South hand.

If East rises with a spade honor to win the trick he will be endplayed into providing a parking place for one of South's losers. Either a spade or a club return will build an extra winner for South in that suit (South must play the ♣2 from hand if East returns a club) while a diamond return will concede a ruff and discard.

If West wins the first round of spades instead of East he will be similarly endplayed. A diamond return gives up a ruff and discard so the best West can do is to return a spade or a club to his partner. East may return a spade to knock out dummy's ♠A entry, but South can unblock the ♣Q and return to the dummy in hearts to cash the ♣A for a spade discard.
